title: Asghar mai teri maa hu
body:
Asghar mai teri maa hu
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaja asghar, aaja asghar..(4)
<<MINI>>
Asghar mai teri maa hu..(2)
Aajao chand mere, teri pyaas mai bujhao
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
Aajao chand mere, teri pyaas mai bujhao
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
Mere laadle kaha'n ho..
mere laadle kaha'n ho..
<<DIVIDER>>
seene tumhe lagaau
<<MINI>>
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
Aajao chand mere, teri pyaas mai bujhao
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Beta tumhara qatil mere saamne khada hai
jaane kyu has raha hai
chadar bhi lut chuki hai
mu kis tarah chupau
<<MINI>>
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
Aajao chand mere, teri pyaas mai bujhao
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Tere jhule ko sakina ro ro ke chumti hai
tujhe ghar mein dhundhti hai, teri maut ki khabar mai
kaise use sunau
<<MINI>>
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
Aajao chand mere, teri pyaas mai bujhao
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Meri jaan jaa rahi hai ye soch soch asghar
is phool se gale par, ye teer kaise jhela
behno ko kya batau
<<MINI>>
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
Aajao chand mere, teri pyaas mai bujhao
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Naize se gir raha hai nanha sa sar tumhara
dil ro raha hai hamara, mere haath to bandhe hai
sar kis tarha uthau
<<MINI>>
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
Aajao chand mere, teri pyaas mai bujhao
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Haye, jhule ke saath beta mere haath jal gaye hai
zalim bhi has rahe hai, teri akhri nishani
haye, kis tarha se bachau
<<MINI>>
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
Aajao chand mere, teri pyaas mai bujhao
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jab raat hogi rann mein hojayega andhera
darna nahi aye beta, daadi kahengi tum se
aa mai tujhe sunau
<<MINI>>
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
Aajao chand mere, teri pyaas mai bujhao
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Tum raat ko hamesha sunte the maa se lori
ab neend aati hogi, phir god mein lita kar
naad e ali sunau
<<MINI>>
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
Aajao chand mere, teri pyaas mai bujhao
Asghar mai teri maa hu..
